description: This file implements a system tray notifier for Android notifications, specifically handling news resource notifications with grouping, deep links, and notification channel management.

classes.name: SystemTrayNotifier
classes.description: A singleton class that posts news notifications to the system tray, grouping multiple news items and creating deep links.

methods.name: postNewsNotifications
methods.description: Posts a list of news resource notifications, creating individual notifications and a summary notification.

methods.name: newsNotificationStyle
methods.description: Creates an inbox style summary for multiple news notifications.

methods.name: createNewsNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification with specified properties.

methods.name: ensureNotificationChannelExists
methods.description: Creates a notification channel if not already present (Android O and above).

methods.name: newsPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a pending intent for a news resource deep link.

methods.name: newsDeepLinkUri
methods.description: Generates a deep link URI for a news resource.
